# My University

> Practice exams, quick answers, and in-depth concepts for Java, Spring, Databases, System Design, Testing, and Algorithms — built for engineers preparing for certifications and for day-to-day work.

My University is a free study platform. Each concept page is a focused, self-contained article (objective, use cases, deep dive, trade-offs) rather than a course chapter, so any single page can be read and cited on its own.

## Java

- [Java Certification Exams](https://university.kurz.fyi/java/exams): Practice exams for Oracle Java certifications with topic-scoped question sets.
- [Java Concepts](https://university.kurz.fyi/java/java-concepts): Core Java language and API concepts explained in depth.
- [JVM Concepts](https://university.kurz.fyi/java/jvm-concepts): JVM internals — memory model, garbage collection, class loading, and performance.
- [Java Minute](https://university.kurz.fyi/java/java-minute): Short, direct answers to specific Java questions.
- [Testing Concepts](https://university.kurz.fyi/java/testing): Unit and integration testing practices for the JVM ecosystem.

## Spring

- [Spring Concepts](https://university.kurz.fyi/spring-concepts): Spring Boot, Spring Security, and Spring Batch explained in depth.

## Databases

- [Database Concepts](https://university.kurz.fyi/databases/database-concepts): Relational database design, indexing, transactions, and query performance.

## System Design

- [System Design Concepts](https://university.kurz.fyi/system-design/system-design-concepts): Distributed systems building blocks — scalability, consistency, caching, and messaging.

## Algorithms

- [Algorithms Concepts](https://university.kurz.fyi/algorithms/algorithms-concepts): Core algorithms and data structures with complexity and trade-off analysis.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://university.kurz.fyi/sitemap.xml): Full machine-readable list of every article URL.
